name: [SANS REWORK +PASSIVES!!] Undertale Fighting Game
desc:
Undertale Fighting game is a game where you can fight other players with characters from Undertale, Glitchtale, Xtale/Underverse or miscellaneous characters.

This game is still in development, expect bugs.

Press or hold L on your opponent to lock on 

Characters: 
Glitchtale Frisk, Sans, Omori, Undyne, Cross/XChara, Misaka, Gaster, Asgore, Betty Noire
